json_schema.title: saltutil.wheel
json_schema.description: Execute a wheel module and function. Must be run on a minion local to the Salt master

name.ui:title: Function name
name.ui:description: The name of the function to run (e.g. minions.connected)

kwargs.ui:title: Keyword arguments
kwargs.ui:description: Any keyword arguments to pass to the wheel function

args.ui:title: Arguments
args.ui:description: Any positional arguments to pass to the wheel function. A common example of this would be the match arg needed for key functions
